opsproc.title: Brakes Temperature Indication on the WHEEL

procdesc.para: The brake energy graph and the brake cooling time table given hereafter permit to determine the ground brake cooling time.

condition.subtitle: false
condition.intro: If MAX reverser thrust was selected for all reversers during the braking phase:

command.para: Enter the brake energy graph: WITH THRUST REVERSERS USE.

condition.subtitle: false
condition.intro: If MAX reverser thrust was NOT selected for all reversers during the braking phase:

command.para: Enter the brake energy graph: WITHOUT THRUST REVERSERS USE.

unlist.para: Determination of the brake energy accumulated during a REJECTED TAKEOFF (RTO):

item.para: Enter with the aircraft takeoff weight (TOW) and with the rejected takeoff speed in kt (IAS)
Apply airport pressure altitude, temperature, wind and runway slope corrections.

unlist.para: Determination of the brake energy accumulated during a LANDING:

item.para: Enter with the aircraft landing weight
Enter with the touch down speed in kt (IAS) if the autobrake was selected and applied or with the manual braking speed in kt (IAS) in the other cases
Apply airport pressure altitude, temperature, wind and runway slope corrections
Correct for brake setting with a preselected autobrake setting (LO, MED) or with MAX PEDAL braking in the other cases.

note.para: In the case of a dispatch with one brake inoperative ( or ), the brake energy accumulated is increased by 34.

condition.intro: In the case of a false BRAKESHOT alert displayed on the EWD:

note.para: In the case of a false BRAKESHOT alert due to a faulty BTMU or a faulty BSCU, the "T.O CONFIG NORMAL” line will not replace the "T.O CONFIG . . TEST" line in the T.O MEMO. Consider normal configuration for takeoff provided that no alert was displayed during the T.O CONFIG TEST.

caution.para: The T.O CONFIG TEST must be maintained pressed to check that there is no alert.
